stem_book: Two litres of N₂ at 0°C and 5 atm pressure is expanded isothermally against a constant external pressure of 1 atm until the pressure of gas reaches 1 atm. Assuming gas to be ideal, calculate the work of expansion (in J; 1 L·atm = 101.3 J).
reason: Print says 'until the pressure of gas reaches 1 L' — misprint for 1 atm, corrected. Key −810.10 J is a rounding slip of 8×101.3 = 810.4 J; same answer.
